facts.text: Cloud execution means renting computers by the hour from a data-center provider to run many simulations in parallel; the compute budget is the money and machine-hours allocated to that work.

facts.text: A simulation campaign with thousands of runs per night needs far more computers than an office owns, motivating rental from cloud providers.
facts.quote: A campaign of thousands of runs per night needs far more computers than an office owns. Cloud providers rent them.

facts.text: The cloud prices found by the booklet were about USD 1.73–1.86 per hour on demand for a machine with one GPU suitable for sensor rendering; a one-year commitment lowers the price.
